feature_contract.goal: Replay the actual captured nonzero mip of offscreen native menu, vehicle and race camera GPU color through independently posed stereo eye CopySubresourceRegion, shader filtered StretchRect and original source timeline without corrupting the game's OM bindings.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A camera-rendered mip slice other than zero is selected by D3D11CalcSubresource(mip,arraySlice,mipLevels), bounded to actual mip dimensions and GPU-copied into the intended owned eye only.
A selected camera mip is staged entirely on GPU and sampled with original clipped UV, while invalid slices/mips reject before GPU mutation and DX9Ex Present, gamepad, FFB and SkyGlow remain intact.

Win32 WARP verifies actual selected mip-1 green pixels, tests invalid mip bounds, and preserves original MRT1, DSV, pixel UAV and authentic Draw evidence; all five mandatory GitHub gates pass on the final source validation SHA.

integration_path: Game-owned menu/vehicle/race offscreen camera texture, array-slice and selected mip -> native source timeline and D3D11 GPU source Copy
Exact per-eye destination, private mip-sized GPU sampled surface and filtered StretchRect -> owned stereo eye render target and ring fence with original game OM restored
batch_components: C++ native game-eye GPU copy and shader postpass select actual source mip dimensions/subresource and reject unsupported MSAA or invalid source crops
Per-eye timeline event carries selected mip from producer preflight through chronological copy/stretched compositor without changing geometry Draw counts
Win32 WARP independent eye mip-1 pixel and invalid mip GPU regression with full MRT/DSV/UAV postpass state preservation
development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: SOURCE-stage BUILD_VERIFIED: selected mip GPU Copy/Stretch and native stereo output code with real Win32 WARP pixels, not full live menu/car/race frame nor Quest 3/VDXR runtime visual parity. Ordered stage path is intended game-frame integration graph; R30 game callsite and user-visible HMD output are not claimed tested.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: NativeDrawPathActive remains explicit opt-in, original D3D9Ex Present, input, FFB and SkyGlow own runtime fallback; rejected source subresource errors do not publish stereo eyes. DXVK remains frozen.
development_strategy.blocking_evidence: Prior native game Copy and shader Stretch always selected mip zero, even when the real camera authored a smaller nonzero mip. The selected mip's dimensions and subresource were not plumbed through the original per-eye timeline, risking incorrect menu/car/race camera pixels. Actual WARP green mip-1 fixture separately tests real GPU copy, filtered stretch and preserves all game render targets.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Win32 WARP native transport run #39074393275 SUCCESS at exact tested GPU source SHA 82005a; actual mip-1 green selected-source eye pixel confirmed and original mip0 restored; native C++ source unchanged until full validation SHA 01677143.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Native GPU WARP rejects nonexistent mip and mip1 crop outside actual subresource, retains original MRT1/DSV/PS-UAV and Draw counters; #39074393275 SUCCESS.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Full camera mip per-eye source timeline and C++ D3D11 GPU Copy/Stretch + WARP regression; all five mandatory GitHub Actions SUCCESS on exact validation SHA 01677143 (Fast #39074617139, Backend #39074617150, Build #39074621514, OpenXR #39074621642, HUD #39074621453).

validation_evidence.blocking_evidence: Original OutRun menu/car/race, Quest3/VDXR HMD, gamepad/FFB runtime and 72Hz performance not executed. Native renderer full completion unproven.
